title: Selene
tagline: A living Moon, painted from pom’s own numbers.
teaser: The phase of the Moon for tonight or any hour you choose, painted live from the same arithmetic the old Berkeley program used. Scrub through a month, run a timelapse, or type a date the old way and watch the shadow line slide across seas and craters.

manPage.synopsis: pom — see the Moon’s phase now, or at any moment you choose.
manPage.description: Keith E. Brandt’s pom printed the phase of the moon as a line of text, using formulas from Peter Duffett-Smith’s Practical Astronomy with Your Calculator. This version draws the moon itself.

howToPlay: Drag the time bar or press ← → to travel through time.
Space plays a month in timelapse; C opens the calendar.
Or type a date after pom, the way the old program took it.
